intro B m hm
simp only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_mul]

rw [mul_one_div, ENNReal.mul_div_cancel_right hm0 (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top m)]
